scope: Wake the existing database-backed interval automation processor on scale-to-zero Cloud Run using a signed Cloud Scheduler HTTP POST. No user rule is enabled and no Gmail mail is sent by this change.

keep: Existing automation rules, conditional database claim, event ledger and canonical workflow-run creation
extend: Google-signed scheduler tick into the existing processor and explicit cloud-vs-process timer mode
replace: Unreliable in-process timer on Cloud Run only

schemaImpact.rollout: No database schema or row changes. The production table currently has zero enabled interval and trigger rules.
schemaImpact.rollback: No schema rollback. Pause the Scheduler job and restore the prior API image or timer mode.

auth.description: Internal POST requires a Google-signed ID token with exact audience, verified email, issuer and dedicated service account identity; missing config fails closed.

tenant.description: The existing processor reads persisted rule owners, never a request-supplied user ID.

approval.description: Scheduler does not enable rules or bypass existing workflow action approvals.

credentials.description: No key file or new secret. Cloud Scheduler mints short-lived OIDC tokens for a dedicated least-privilege service account.

egress.description: A scheduled HTTPS POST invokes only the Cloud Run API internal tick path.

cost.description: User approved Cloud Scheduler service and possible charges; each tick is bounded by the existing ten-rule batch.

billing.description: No product payment or billing change.

tests.scope: Missing token/config, wrong issuer or email, unverified email and signature verification failure are denied; exact identity accepted.
Backend TypeScript compilation and pinned dependency checks.

tests.command: Signed Cloud Scheduler force-run and anonymous endpoint denial
tests.scope: Pending deployed live proof; no user automation rules will be enabled for this check.

architecture.reason: Cloud Scheduler is only a wake-up signal to the existing processor, not a second planner, workflow scheduler or executor.

rollout: Merge after source-bound CI. Deploy pinned merge SHA to Cloud Run manually, configure the dedicated OIDC job, prove an unsigned request is denied and a signed tick succeeds, then set cloud scheduler mode. Do not switch xroga.com frontend traffic or activate rules here.
rollback: Pause the Cloud Scheduler job and switch XROGA_AUTOMATION_SCHEDULER_MODE away from cloud, or roll back to the previous ready Cloud Run revision. Preserve automation rows and event history.
